title: nf-raffle event config
description: Schema for event_configs/<event>.json. Generate new configs with scripts/new_event.py.

event_name.description: Human-readable event name, shown on the ticket.

help.description: One-line description of the event and what participants must provide.

winner_announcement.description: When the winner is announced, e.g. '3pm EDT on October 23rd, 2026'. Printed in the privacy notice and on the ticket.

destination_url.description: Google Form formResponse URL the entry is POSTed to.

required_fields.description: Participant-supplied fields the pipeline requires on the command line. Must include every participant question marked Required in the Google Form.

form_fields.description: Maps pipeline fields to Google Form entry IDs. Fields without a mapping are not sent.

run_name.description: Nextflow run name; also the ticket number.

platform_enabled.description: 'true' when Seqera Platform monitoring (tower.enabled) is on.

hostname.description: Hostname of the machine that ran the entry task.

workspace_id.description: TOWER_WORKSPACE_ID, set when monitored by or launched from Seqera Platform.

platform_workflow_id.description: TOWER_WORKFLOW_ID, set when launched from Seqera Platform.

entry_id.description: Google Form entry ID, e.g. entry.1234567890.
